Registered patients by small area and practice

Source: R/data_cornwall.R
cornwall_flows.Rd

Residents of each Cornwall and Isles of Scilly small area registered at each of the 55 ICB practices, as observed flows for calibrating allocation models.

Usage

cornwall_flows

Format

A data frame with 3,188 rows (non-zero pairs only) and columns:

lsoa

LSOA 2021 code (see cornwall_lsoa).

practice

Practice code (see cornwall_gp).

patients

Registered patients (integer, unrounded and unsuppressed).

Source

NHS England, Patients Registered at a GP Practice, July 2026 (LSOA 2021 file), Open Government Licence v3.0. See system.file("COPYRIGHTS", package = "spax").

Details

Registration records where people are attached, not how often they use services. Residents registered outside the ICB are summarised in cornwall_lsoa$registered_out.

See also

cornwall_gp, cornwall_lsoa, cornwall_travel

Examples

head(cornwall_flows)
#>        lsoa practice patients
#> 1 E01018750   L82012     2185
#> 2 E01018750   L82016       35
#> 3 E01018750   L82025        1
#> 4 E01018750   L82046        4
#> 5 E01018750   L82066        1
#> 6 E01018751   L82012     1691
# Practice totals from Cornwall residents
head(sort(tapply(cornwall_flows$patients, cornwall_flows$practice, sum),
          decreasing = TRUE))
#> Y04957 L82041 L82010 L82006 L82001 L82028 
#>  32755  29174  23824  19800  19387  17652
